title: Zesty American Corn Arepa Gratin
description: A zesty, bouncy corn arepa gratin that melts mozzarella inside a crispy corn crust, served from a fondue pot for a fun communal twist.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F and set fondue pot over low heat for steady warmth.
Whisk corn flour, water, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp sugar until smooth; let rest 5 minutes.
Press dough into a 9x9 inch pan lined inside fondue pot, forming a crust about 1/2 inch thick; bake for 10 minutes until firm.
Sprinkle mozzarella evenly over crust, then drizzle olive oil and sprinkle chili flakes, oregano, paprika, and pepper.
Return pot to oven and bake another 15 minutes until cheese melts and edges turn golden.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve directly from fondue pot, slicing into squares with a wooden spoon for a communal presentation.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or a squeeze of lime for extra zest.
Enjoy warm as a hearty lunch or side dish.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
